description: This file defines a servlet class 'ViewCustomer' that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve and display a list of customers from the database, forwarding the data to a JSP page for rendering.

classes.name: ViewCustomer
classes.description: A servlet class for viewing customers, extending HttpServlet and handling GET requests to fetch customer data and forward to a JSP view.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve all customers from the database and forwards the request to the 'CustDash.jsp' page with customer data.
